morphology.pattern_note: 本条按输入包处理为 pelékat 的纺织品义：第一音节 e 为 /ə/，第二音节 é 为 /e/。整词记忆，不拆为 pe- + lekat；表示胶黏剂或贴纸的同形词须另作分析。word_family 所列为相关复合词组。

senses.zh_definition: 一种带条纹或格纹图案的沙笼布，亦指用这种布制成的沙笼，通常由男性穿着。
senses.en_definition: A striped or checked sarong cloth, or a sarong made from it, commonly worn by men.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis kain sarung yang bercorak jalur-jalur atau petak-petak, lazimnya dipakai oleh lelaki.
senses.nuances: 常见完整说法是 kain pelekat。输入包指定的是读作 pelékat 的纺织品义；胶黏剂、贴纸等同形词义不纳入本条。该词条的词根判断只适用于此纺织品义。[DBP：pelekat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pelekat)。

collocations.en: to wear a checked or striped sarong

dual_scenarios.context: 文化展览 / 新闻介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran tersebut menampilkan koleksi kain pelekat yang bercorak jalur dan petak.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该展览展出了多款条纹和格纹沙笼布。
dual_scenarios.en: The exhibition features a collection of striped and checked sarong cloths.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 家人准备去祈祷室
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Abang dah pakai kain pelekat, nak pergi surau kejap.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Abang sudah memakai kain pelekat dan hendak pergi ke surau sebentar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 哥哥已经穿好沙笼，准备去祈祷室一趟。
dual_scenarios.en: My older brother has put on his sarong and is heading to the prayer hall for a while.
spoken_features: kejap 对应 sekejap 或 sebentar。
口语去向表达 pergi surau 可省略标准语中的 ke。

messages.speaker: Aina (妹妹)
messages.ms_spoken: Abang dah pakai kain pelekat ke? Nak pergi surau sekarang?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah abang sudah memakai kain pelekat? Adakah abang hendak pergi ke surau sekarang?
messages.zh: 哥，你穿好沙笼了吗？现在要去祈祷室？
messages.en: Have you put your sarong on? Are you heading to the prayer hall now?

messages.speaker: Hakim (哥哥)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Kain pelekat biru tu abang pakai. Nak keluar kejap lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Abang memakai kain pelekat biru itu. Abang hendak keluar sebentar lagi.
messages.zh: 穿好了，我穿的是那条蓝色沙笼。再过一会儿就出门。
messages.en: Yes, I'm wearing the blue one. I'll head out in a little while.

etymology.historical_story: The textile name pelekat is commonly connected with Pulicat, a trading town on India's Coromandel Coast. A nineteenth-century account explicitly equates the place-name Pelekat with Pulicat, supporting that association without establishing every stage of the textile word's transmission. The name recalls maritime connections through which place names and cloth names travelled together. [Historical account](https://www.sabrizain.org/malaya/library/jsbras20.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pe-lé-kat 分成三拍，同时想象沙笼上三道条纹：听到 pelekat，就想到条纹、格纹 kain sarung；此处别联想到胶水。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 中性服饰名称。谈长辈衣着时可自然称 kain pelekat；避免把穿沙笼的人一概描述为懒散或衣着不体面。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合居家、服饰、文化和部分宗教活动语境。是否适合某个正式场合，应依据活动着装要求；沙笼并非只供宗教用途。
